lessons_used: Evidence is still thin to establish rules on which kinds of change work or fail, as each kind of change has only one test so far.
Predictions were consistently too high: both tests predicted positive gains (+14.0% and +6.0%), but both resulted in negative outcomes (-7.2% after noise correction).

candidates.title: Interactive Desktop Placement Preview
candidates.change: Redesigns the final intro screen with a simulated desktop view stage so users can test dragging, placing, and summoning their pet before completing onboarding.
candidates.why: Support receives multiple emails about pets not appearing on the desktop, and the finish step conversion drops to 64.8% with high completion time.

candidates.change: Redesigns the friend selection screen into a split view with fast preset pet archetypes and instant preview cards.
candidates.why: Adoption stage has low conversion (60.9%) and long duration (median 89s / mean 1017s), alongside reported custom generation failures.

shipped: Home Intro Welcome Spotlight with Direct Desktop Test
lessons_next: Evidence is still thin to establish rules on which kinds of change work or fail, as each kind of change has only one test so far.
Predictions were too high for failed tests: both [adoption, redesign] (predicted +14.0%, actual -7.4%) and [sign_in, reorder] (predicted +6.0%, actual -7.4%) yielded negative results.
Predictions were too low for winning tests: [finish, redesign] exceeded expectations (predicted +3.0%, actual +5.0%).
